column1: # rt_entries.tsv -- THE RUNTIME ENTRY TABLE (DESIGN-PLAN zeta-layout step 5, stage 5a; ARCH-ZETA-LAYOUT-ONE-SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md section 3 R4; R-2019): one row per runtime symbol emitted code calls.

# sym        the symbol a template names in x86("call"), x86("call_bare") or x86_rtcc_call, or that src/runtime/rtx registers as an asm-runtime entry (RTX_FUNC, RTX_ENTRY): the emitter asks the table about both.
# conv       leaf | gen | open | asm: "asm" where src/runtime/rtx declares it with RTX_FUNC or RTX_ENTRY; "-" where no source states it (stage 5b declares it at the definition).

# rc         what rides rax:rdx at return: DESCR | OTHER | VOID | UNKNOWN, DERIVED from the built libscrip_rt.so (the DWARF return type of an allocating symbol; util_gen_rt_entry_table.py --sync-alloc, lib_rt_alloc_derive.py); "-" where the symbol does not reach the allocator.

# allocates  1 when the symbol's call graph reaches rt_gcheap_alloc in the built libscrip_rt.so (tail jumps are edges), 0 when it does not (a libc import allocates nothing on the collected heap); DERIVED, --check-alloc compares and the gate holds it.

# clobbers   which of the four RTCC registers (r8 r9 r10 r11) the entry hands back changed; "none" is an explicit empty mask; "-" where no source states it. The asm rows are DERIVED from the assembled objects (util_gen_rt_entry_table.py --sync-asm; --check-asm refuses a stale one) and the emitter reads them (stage 5c).

# transfers  conv leaf|gen|open: may return an address the box jumps to (the rt_call_next_t shape): "-" until stage 5b declares it. conv asm: 1 DECLARES A TRANSFER ENTRY (ARCH-RT-CALL-PROTOCOL.md section 16), an entry that switches the stack

#            and leaves into a parked activation, or tails into one; the declaration is this cell, never inferred, and util_rtx_abi_walk.py reads it through --walker-table. 1:rax|rdx names the registers that carry the record at entry

#            (rax rcx rdx rsi rdi); a plain 1 takes its record from a call result (mov R, rax right after the call). A transfer entry's clobbers read none: its transfer exit is judged as the parked call's return.

# src        which sources state the row: call (a template names it), alloc (the binary's call graph reaches the allocator from it), clob (the objects derive its clobbers), asm (src/runtime/rtx registers it), import.
